name: Fatima Al-Hassan

employment.title: Senior Product Manager, Seller & Ads Platform
employment.summary: Owned roadmap for seller-facing reporting and campaign optimization features for Amazon Ads; led discovery and translated insights into prioritized epics; implemented experimentation for bidding recommendations; partnered with Data Science/Applied ML on success metrics and dashboards; drove cross-functional launch planning for campaign insights and anomaly detection; managed product governance including backlog health, PR/BRD standards, and quarterly business reviews.

employment.title: Product Manager, Developer Tools (APIs & Integrations)
employment.summary: Owned Jira/Confluence developer integrations product focused on API reliability, auth flows, and onboarding; ran customer interviews to define requirements; launched documentation refresh and example gallery; partnered with Engineering/Security/Platform to add rate-limiting and request tracing; managed roadmap and stakeholder communications across Sales Engineering/Partner/Support; defined KPIs and ran usability tests to iterate on onboarding and error messaging.

employment.title: Product Manager, Workforce Optimization (Program Management)
employment.summary: Supported product strategy and delivery for internal workforce tooling; streamlined scheduling workflows to reduce manual effort (~20%); partnered with ops leaders to identify bottlenecks and translate into product requirements; developed dashboards and operational metrics (forecast accuracy, staffing utilization, SLA adherence); coordinated phased rollouts with training materials, QA checklists, and feedback loops.
